title: Debloater profile
description: A named selection of changes, in a form that can be exported from one site and imported into another. It is the configuration document of cli-export.schema.json with a name and a creation date, and without the two fields that describe where it came from: a profile is meant to travel, and a document carrying its origin site invites somebody to treat it as belonging to that site. Importing a profile never applies anything — it pre-fills a preview, and the ordinary snapshot, verification and rollback run does the applying.

schema_version.description: Format version of this document. Bumped only when the shape changes incompatibly.

name.description: What a person calls this profile. Free text, because it is for a person; length-bounded because it is stored and displayed.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601. When the profile was made, not when it was exported — two exports of one profile are the same profile and are byte-identical.

registry_hash.description: Hash of the change registry this profile was written against. Provenance, not a gate: a mismatch is worth a warning, since a change may mean something slightly different now, but it never refuses the import.

intent_profile.description: What the site is for and how much change its owner wants. Travels with the selection because the two were decided together.

selection.description: Selected changes, keyed by tweak id, each with the parameters it was selected with. An empty object is valid and means a profile that selects nothing, which is a legitimate thing to save.
